decisions.statement: The chain starts only where the station opened is the player's own assistant.
The chain starts only where the assistant out at the time is the ragpicker.
The player summons the ragpicker, and the chain summons everyone after.
Talking to one of the player's own assistants picks that assistant's own option.
Which option is the assistant's own is read from its type rather than its words.
Either type the game gives a station counts as a deconstructor's own option.
An option is picked whether the run is under way or not.
A merchant is called when the station closes, and a banker when the store does.
The banker is sent away when the bank closes, and nobody else is.
Each role names the assistants filling it, the one Alan is used to first.
A summon waits out whatever cooldown the collectible has left.
A step left alone longer than the window ends the chain rather than carrying on.
A venue is closed once nothing the addon started there is still running.
A venue is held a moment after falling quiet before it is closed.
A venue still working past the limit is left for the player to close.
A leg with nothing to do is walked all the same.
Nothing here sells, deconstructs or banks anything.
Which assistant fills which role is written here rather than read from the game.

definition: the run of assistants that talking to the ragpicker sets off
